title: Bob, Shag & Bangs: Natural Wave Haircuts
text:
2026 Hair Trends: freedom, Texture, and Bold Color dominate, Says Top Stylist Petra Vavrušková
A shift towards playful textures, liberated styles, and rich color palettes will define hair fashion in 2026, according to leading stylist Petra Vavrušková. With a clientele including prominent figures like Dagmar Havlová, Eva Pavlová, and Lucie Bílá, Vavrušková is uniquely positioned to forecast the year’s most sought-after looks.
The Rise of Short Hair and Textured Styles
The coming year signals a departure from the dominance of long hair, with shorter styles taking centre stage. Vavrušková emphasizes that texture, natural waves, and relaxed hairstyles will be paramount. “This style of hair fashion perfectly describes me,” she states. “I love femininity, playfulness and freedom. I like to play with textures, hair movement, but also color so that every hairstyle has a soul and personality. I love refinement and casual elegance.”
The Bob’s Continued reign
The bob – in all its variations – will continue to be a defining haircut of 2026. Building on the momentum of 2025, the style will evolve into both sleek, sharply-defined iterations and more relaxed, tousled versions. A longer bob, reaching the neck and inspired by French styling, will offer a polished, voluminous look. Simultaneously, a textured, more casual bob will provide a counterpoint, offering a “just woke up like this” aesthetic.According to Vavrušková, waves will be a key element in enhancing this popular cut.
Shag Haircuts: Edgy and Effortless
For those seeking a bolder statement, the shag haircut – characterized by messy layers – is poised to be a standout trend. “The so-called shag cut, which stands out with messy layers, provides the coolest look,” the renowned hairdresser explains. This versatile style creates natural volume and movement, working well across various hair lengths, but especially shines on semi-long hair.
Bangs and Natural Movement
A cropped bangs style, gently rounded and framing the cheeks, offers a charming and practical choice to straight haircuts. Vavrušková notes that this style is easier to grow out and requires less frequent maintenance. it pairs beautifully with both natural waves and defined, rebellious curls, creating a modern and casually wild look, especially suited for longer hair.
Color Trends: Richness and Sophistication
In 2026, uniform hair colors will be favored for their elegance, ranging from ice blonde to deep brown tones. Dark chocolate, espresso, and warm brown colors are predicted to be particularly popular. Inspired by street style from Paris Fashion Week, saffron and other orange shades will also gain prominence, alongside sophisticated rusty and copper tones.
